+## V3 candidate regression
+
+`v3-candidate-regression.yml` validates pull requests targeting `main` when Go
+source, the selected process E2E scenarios, their shared harness, or workflow
+contracts change. Manual dispatch runs the selected ref once with no command
+inputs. Both paths have only `contents: read`, credential-free exact-SHA
+checkouts, no persistent Go cache, and no cloud or publication authority.
+The named jobs are `Candidate default suite (go-unit)` and
+`Candidate migration and messaging E2E`; each has a 35-minute bound, and the
+second starts only after the first passes.
+
+The first job freezes the PR event's exact base SHA, or the fetched `origin/main`
+SHA for a manual run, and requires that revision to be an ancestor of the tested
+commit. Its `go-unit` named check is read from that revision's
+`.github/review-agent/policy.json`. The Workflow consumes the command arguments,
+working directory, timeout and combined output limit directly from that policy;
+it does not redefine the check or its path selector. `GOFLAGS=-p=2` bounds package
+build/test concurrency. Exceeding either policy limit fails the job. The shared
+candidate command runner starts each command in its own session, then cleans all
+live members of that SID, including server nodes with separate process groups.
+The retained receipt binds source SHA, policy SHA and
+digest, command, environment, duration, exit status and bounded combined
+stdout/stderr. The workflow's Python static contracts run before the named check.
+
+The second job builds one `e2e`-tagged server from the same exact source SHA.
+Every scenario uses that frozen `WK_E2E_BINARY`, with its SHA256 checked before
+each scenario and after the last. It runs the complete default package tests
+for `ordinary_history` (all five migration topologies, serial subtests),
+`cross_node_delivery`, and `self_chat`, in that order. The existing per-package
+test deadlines remain unchanged; outer command deadlines bound build and test
+processes. A 64 MiB combined output limit bounds each E2E/build command's
+stdout and stderr, retained in separate files. There is no
+automatic retry or test-name filter. A failed scenario prevents later scenarios
+from running and preserves their explicit `not_run` state. The artifact includes
+commands, case results, JSONL logs, the self-chat report when produced, binary
+digest and build metadata, but excludes the server executable.
+
+For normal exit, test failure, deadline, output-limit refusal and handled
+SIGINT/SIGTERM, the runner rechecks each process SID before TERM/KILL, excludes
+zombies, and records the original command outcome plus a separate cleanup
+receipt. The cleanup attempt allows two seconds for TERM and two for KILL;
+repeated cancellation signals cannot interrupt that attempt. Failed process
+enumeration remains unverified, and nonzero survivors or unverified cleanup
+prevent a passing result. There is no host-wide process-name kill.
+
+Both jobs reject tracked-source mutation and attempt evidence upload after
+success, failure, or cancellation, retaining each exact run/attempt for 14 days.
+SIGKILL, hard job cancellation or runner loss can prevent cleanup or upload;
+missing or incomplete cleanup/artifacts are inconclusive, never zero-survivor
+proof. A new PR revision cancels the older PR run; cancellation is never
+passing evidence. Inspect the exact source SHA, run attempt, both job results,
+and receipts before reusing a result. Preserve a failure and diagnose its cause
+before any deliberate rerun. A pass covers this candidate regression scope;
+performance gates, released SDK acceptance, long-duration stability and signed
+native-package publication remain separate release requirements.

+name: Safety Automation - V3 Candidate Regression
+run-name: >-
+  V3 Candidate Regression ${{ github.event_name }}
+  ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref_name }} attempt ${{ github.run_attempt }}
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/v3-candidate-regression.yml"
+      - ".github/workflows/README.md"
+      - ".github/review-agent/policy.json"
+      - "go.mod"
+      - "go.sum"
+      - "cmd/**"
+      - "internal/**"
+      - "pkg/**"
+      - "scripts/**"
+      - "scripts/v3_candidate_workflow_contract_test.py"
+      - "docker/**"
+      - "test/e2e/AGENTS.md"
+      - "test/e2e/message/AGENTS.md"
+      - "test/e2e/migration/**"
+      - "test/e2e/message/cross_node_delivery/**"
+      - "test/e2e/message/self_chat/**"
+      - "test/e2e/suite/**"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: v3-candidate-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+jobs:
+  default-suite:
+    name: Candidate default suite (go-unit)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    outputs:
+      policy-sha: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.policy-sha }}
+    env:
+      GOWORK: "off"
+      GOFLAGS: "-p=2"
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Freeze source and named-check authority
+        id: identity
+        env:
+          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/v3-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/default
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
+          printf 'EVIDENCE_DIR=%s\n' "$EVIDENCE_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          [[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$SOURCE_SHA" ]]
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
+          policy_sha="${BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse origin/main)}"
+          [[ "$policy_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
+          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$policy_sha" HEAD
+          git show "$policy_sha:.github/review-agent/policy.json" > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/policy.json"
+          policy_sha256="$(sha256sum "$EVIDENCE_DIR/policy.json" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
+          jq -n --arg source_sha "$SOURCE_SHA" --arg policy_sha "$policy_sha" \
+            --arg policy_sha256 "$policy_sha256" --arg event "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" \
+            --arg run_id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --arg run_attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
+            '{source_sha:$source_sha,policy_sha:$policy_sha,policy_sha256:$policy_sha256,event:$event,run_id:$run_id,run_attempt:$run_attempt}' \
+            > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/identity.json"
+          printf 'policy-sha=%s\n' "$policy_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Validate workflow static contracts
+        run: python3 scripts/v3_candidate_workflow_contract_test.py
+      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6.5
+        with:
+          go-version-file: go.mod
+          cache: false
+      - name: Run frozen go-unit named check once
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          go version > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/go-version.txt"
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import importlib.util
+
+          evidence = Path(os.environ["EVIDENCE_DIR"])
+          root = Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]).resolve()
+          policy = json.loads((evidence / "policy.json").read_text())
+          check = policy["trusted_checks"]["go-unit"]
+          arguments = check["arguments"]
+          working_dir = check["working_dir"]
+          timeout_seconds = check["timeout_seconds"]
+          max_output_bytes = check["max_output_bytes"]
+          if (not isinstance(arguments, list) or not arguments or
+                  not all(isinstance(arg, str) and arg for arg in arguments) or
+                  not isinstance(working_dir, str) or
+                  type(timeout_seconds) is not int or timeout_seconds <= 0 or
+                  type(max_output_bytes) is not int or max_output_bytes <= 0):
+              raise SystemExit("invalid frozen go-unit policy")
+          cwd = (root / working_dir).resolve()
+          if not cwd.is_relative_to(root) or not cwd.is_dir():
+              raise SystemExit("go-unit working directory escapes checkout")
+          spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate_runner", root / "scripts/run-v3-candidate-check.py")
+          runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+          spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
+          result = runner.run_command(arguments, cwd, evidence, timeout_seconds, max_output_bytes,
+                                      metadata={"named_check": "go-unit", "working_dir": working_dir,
+                                                "environment": {"GOWORK": "off", "GOFLAGS": os.environ["GOFLAGS"]}})
+          print(json.dumps(result))
+          raise SystemExit(result["wrapper_exit_code"])
+          PY
+      - name: Reject tracked-tree mutation
+        if: always()
+        run: git diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: v3-candidate-default-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ env.EVIDENCE_DIR }}
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14
+
+  process-e2e:
+    name: Candidate migration and messaging E2E
+    needs: default-suite
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    env:
+      GOWORK: "off"
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Record exact source and initial case state
+        env:
+          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
+          POLICY_SHA: ${{ needs.default-suite.outputs.policy-sha }}
+          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/v3-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/e2e
+          WK_E2E_BINARY: ${{ runner.temp }}/v3-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/e2e/wukongim-e2e
+          WK_E2E_SELF_CHAT_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/v3-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/e2e/self_chat/report.json
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
+          printf 'EVIDENCE_DIR=%s\nWK_E2E_BINARY=%s\nWK_E2E_SELF_CHAT_REPORT=%s\n' \
+            "$EVIDENCE_DIR" "$WK_E2E_BINARY" "$WK_E2E_SELF_CHAT_REPORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          [[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$SOURCE_SHA" ]]
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
+          jq -n --arg source_sha "$SOURCE_SHA" --arg policy_sha "$POLICY_SHA" \
+            --arg run_id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --arg run_attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
+            '{source_sha:$source_sha,policy_sha:$policy_sha,run_id:$run_id,run_attempt:$run_attempt}' \
+            > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/identity.json"
+          for case_name in build ordinary_history cross_node_delivery self_chat; do
+            mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE_DIR/$case_name"
+            printf '{"status":"not_run"}\n' > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/$case_name/result.json"
+          done
+      - uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6.5
+        with:
+          go-version-file: go.mod
+          cache: false
+      - name: Build once and run migration, cross-node delivery, and self-chat serially
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          go version > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/go-version.txt"
+          run_case() {
+            local case_name="$1" timeout_seconds="$2"
+            shift 2
+            python3 -B scripts/run-v3-candidate-check.py \
+              --evidence-dir "$EVIDENCE_DIR/$case_name" \
+              --timeout-seconds "$timeout_seconds" --max-output-bytes 67108864 \
+              --stdout-name stdout.jsonl --split-output -- "$@"
+          }
+          run_case build 720 go build -tags=e2e -o "$WK_E2E_BINARY" ./cmd/wukongim
+          sha256sum "$WK_E2E_BINARY" > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary.sha256"
+          go version -m "$WK_E2E_BINARY" > "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary-build-info.txt"
+          sha256sum --check "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary.sha256"
+          run_case ordinary_history 780 go test -tags=e2e ./test/e2e/migration/ordinary_history -count=1 -timeout=12m -p=1 -parallel=1 -json
+          sha256sum --check "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary.sha256"
+          run_case cross_node_delivery 180 go test -tags=e2e ./test/e2e/message/cross_node_delivery -count=1 -timeout=2m -p=1 -json
+          sha256sum --check "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary.sha256"
+          run_case self_chat 300 go test -tags=e2e ./test/e2e/message/self_chat -count=1 -timeout=4m -p=1 -json
+          sha256sum --check "$EVIDENCE_DIR/binary.sha256"
+      - name: Reject tracked-tree mutation
+        if: always()
+        run: git diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: v3-candidate-e2e-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ env.EVIDENCE_DIR }}
+            !${{ env.WK_E2E_BINARY }}
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14

+# V3 recovery candidate integration
+
+The release candidate fixes a public readiness classification failure after
+original-v2 migration and cluster restart. Incomplete or unavailable recovery
+proofs remain retryable across local and RPC reads; permanent storage/proof
+errors and write fencing retain their existing behavior. This change does not
+relax quorum admission or make uncommitted messages readable.
+
+The product repair was first committed as
+`98c25091bb9587a303af982bb14bf4cedd9aa110`. This integration branch selects that
+repair and its regression fixtures from the evidence branch instead of merging
+hundreds of archived observations into one review. The initial integration head
+`5f3ecdf93e762a1b1551b44977a44f2e63c97802` matched qualified candidate
+`ef798352c40a94e57f768f76b2f4713712f827fe` in `cmd`, `internal`, `pkg`, `go.mod`
+and `go.sum`. Its first Linux default-suite run exposed the two failures below.
+The subsequent MQTT fix changes product code, so that earlier tree equivalence
+does not certify the updated candidate. Exact new-head results belong in the PR
+and retained readiness evidence, without rewriting the first failed attempt.
+
+## Failures found by candidate integration
+
+[Candidate run 39546957124](https://github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/actions/runs/39546957124)
+attempt 1 failed two default-suite assertions; migration/messaging E2E was skipped.
+The runner preserved exit 1 and verified Linux session cleanup with zero remaining
+members. The independent SDK, Manager, native-package and three-node runs passed
+on the initial head; those do not override the default-suite failure.
+
+- MQTT cancellation: nested subscription, projection and source scopes only
+  checked their immediate parent while cancellation of the original caller
+  propagated asynchronously. A deterministic delayed-cancellation case drove
+  the real source CAS conflict path and reproduced a pending-drain result and
+  subsequent reads after caller cancellation. Carry only private scope ancestry
+  and synchronously check each ancestor and Owner gate. Preserve the deadline
+  minimum, uncertainty classification and source sealing constraints. Regression
+  assertions require cancellation, no subsequent contention reads and an unchanged
+  unsealed binding; the default-off preview boundary remains unchanged.
+- Replication fixture: its single-item-only rejection bypassed coalesced batches.
+  Every missing repair in six failures across 150 instrumented runs already had
+  the exact durable proposal on the follower. Reject each selected batch item,
+  preserve aligned accepted results, and verify exact repair keys. A deterministic
+  real-batcher regression failed before the fixture fix; the original 66-item
+  scenario passed 150/150 afterward, followed by the full package and focused race
+  checks. No replication product code or expectation was weakened.
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Bound one credential-free candidate check and reclaim its owned session."""
+
+import argparse
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import selectors
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import time
+
+
+class CommandInterrupted(Exception):
+    """Remain visible to selectors, which may swallow InterruptedError itself."""
+
+
+def session_members(session_id):
+    """Find live members across all process groups; enumeration errors are fatal."""
+    members = []
+    if Path("/proc/self/stat").exists():
+        for entry in Path("/proc").iterdir():
+            if not entry.name.isdigit():
+                continue
+            try:
+                fields = (entry / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()
+                if int(fields[3]) == session_id and fields[0] != "Z":
+                    members.append(int(entry.name))
+            except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
+                pass
+    else:
+        # macOS ps's session field is not a numeric SID. Query identity via getsid.
+        pids = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-axo", "pid="], text=True, timeout=5)
+        for value in pids.split():
+            pid = int(value)
+            try:
+                if os.getsid(pid) != session_id:
+                    continue
+                state = subprocess.run(["ps", "-p", str(pid), "-o", "stat="],
+                                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
+                if state.returncode != 0 or not state.stdout.strip():
+                    # A disappeared process is harmless; an unreadable live one is not.
+                    os.getsid(pid)
+                    raise RuntimeError(f"cannot inspect live session member {pid}")
+                if not state.stdout.lstrip().startswith("Z"):
+                    members.append(pid)
+            except ProcessLookupError:
+                pass
+    return sorted(members)
+
+
+def cleanup_session(session_id):
+    """Reclaim only this command's new SID, including separately grouped nodes."""
+    receipt = {"session_id": session_id, "verified": False, "complete": False,
+               "initial_processes": None, "remaining_processes": None}
+    try:
+        if session_id == os.getsid(0):
+            raise RuntimeError("refusing to clean the orchestrator session")
+        receipt["initial_processes"] = session_members(session_id)
+        # Stay below the runner's cancellation grace; repeated signals are masked by caller.
+        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGKILL):
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
+            while True:
+                members = session_members(session_id)
+                receipt["remaining_processes"] = members
+                if not members:
+                    receipt.update(verified=True, complete=True)
+                    return receipt
+                for pid in members:
+                    try:
+                        # Recheck SID immediately before signalling, including after PID reuse.
+                        if os.getsid(pid) == session_id:
+                            os.kill(pid, sig)
+                    except ProcessLookupError:
+                        pass
+                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                    break
+                time.sleep(0.05)
+        receipt["remaining_processes"] = session_members(session_id)
+        receipt.update(verified=True, complete=not receipt["remaining_processes"])
+    except Exception as error:
+        receipt["error"] = str(error)
+    return receipt
+
+
+def write_json(path, value):
+    """Replace receipts atomically so a canceled write cannot look complete."""
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
+    temporary.replace(path)
+
+
+def run_command(arguments, cwd, evidence, timeout_seconds, max_output_bytes,
+                stdout_name="stdout-stderr.log", split_output=False, metadata=None):
+    """Preserve command outcome and independently prove cleanup on every exit path."""
+    evidence = Path(evidence)
+    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    command = {"arguments": arguments, "working_dir": str(cwd),
+               "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds, "max_output_bytes": max_output_bytes}
+    command.update(metadata or {})
+    write_json(evidence / "command.json", command)
+    result = {"status": "running", "exit_code": None, "session_id": None,
+              "output_bytes": 0, "output_truncated": False, "passed": False}
+    write_json(evidence / "result.json", result)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    process = None
+    received_signal = None
+
+    def interrupt(signum, _frame):
+        nonlocal received_signal
+        received_signal = signum
+        raise CommandInterrupted(f"received signal {signum}")
+
+    previous_signals = {sig: signal.signal(sig, interrupt)
+                        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT)}
+    with ExitStack() as stack:
+        selector = stack.enter_context(selectors.DefaultSelector())
+
+        def consume(key):
+            """Keep combined stdout/stderr bounded, including the terminal pipe tail."""
+            try:
+                chunk = os.read(key.fd, 65536)
+            except BlockingIOError:
+                return False
+            if not chunk:
+                selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
+                return False
+            previous = result["output_bytes"]
+            result["output_bytes"] += len(chunk)
+            key.data.write(chunk[:max(0, max_output_bytes - previous)])
+            if result["output_bytes"] > max_output_bytes:
+                result["output_truncated"] = True
+            return True
+
+        try:
+            output = stack.enter_context((evidence / stdout_name).open("wb"))
+            error_output = stack.enter_context((evidence / "stderr.log").open("wb")) if split_output else output
+            process = subprocess.Popen(arguments, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE if split_output else subprocess.STDOUT,
+                                       start_new_session=True)
+            result["session_id"] = process.pid
+            for stream, destination in ((process.stdout, output), (process.stderr, error_output)):
+                if stream is not None:
+                    stack.callback(stream.close)
+                    os.set_blocking(stream.fileno(), False)
+                    selector.register(stream, selectors.EVENT_READ, destination)
+            while True:
+                for key, _ in selector.select(0.05):
+                    consume(key)
+                # A failed driver must not turn into a timeout because a node holds its pipe.
+                result["exit_code"] = process.poll()
+                if result["output_truncated"]:
+                    result["status"] = "output_limit"
+                    break
+                if result["exit_code"] is not None:
+                    result["status"] = "passed" if result["exit_code"] == 0 else "failed"
+                    break
+                if time.monotonic() - started >= timeout_seconds:
+                    result["status"] = "timeout"
+                    break
+        except BaseException as error:
+            result.update(status="interrupted" if isinstance(error, (CommandInterrupted, KeyboardInterrupt)) else "runner_error",
+                          error=str(error))
+        finally:
+            # Do not let a second runner cancellation interrupt owned-session cleanup.
+            for sig in previous_signals:
+                signal.signal(sig, signal.SIG_IGN)
+            if process is not None:
+                result["cleanup"] = cleanup_session(process.pid)
+                try:
+                    result["exit_code"] = process.wait(timeout=1)
+                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                    result["cleanup"].update(complete=False, error="driver did not exit after cleanup")
+                # Cleanup has stopped writers; nonblocking drain preserves any final output.
+                for key in list(selector.get_map().values()):
+                    while consume(key):
+                        if result["output_truncated"]:
+                            break
+            else:
+                result["cleanup"] = {"session_id": None, "verified": True, "complete": True,
+                                     "initial_processes": [], "remaining_processes": []}
+            result["command_status"] = result["status"]
+            if result["status"] == "passed" and result["output_truncated"]:
+                result["status"] = "output_limit"
+            if result["status"] == "passed" and not result["cleanup"]["complete"]:
+                result["status"] = "cleanup_failed"
+            result["passed"] = result["status"] == "passed" and result["cleanup"]["complete"]
+            result["wrapper_exit_code"] = 0 if result["passed"] else {
+                "failed": result["exit_code"] if (result["exit_code"] or 0) > 0 else 1,
+                "timeout": 124, "output_limit": 125,
+                "interrupted": 128 + (received_signal or signal.SIGINT),
+            }.get(result["status"], 1)
+            result["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
+            write_json(evidence / "result.json", result)
+            for sig, handler in previous_signals.items():
+                signal.signal(sig, handler)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--evidence-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=int, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-output-bytes", type=int, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--stdout-name", default="stdout-stderr.log")
+    parser.add_argument("--split-output", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("arguments", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    arguments = args.arguments[1:] if args.arguments[:1] == ["--"] else args.arguments
+    if not arguments or args.timeout_seconds <= 0 or args.max_output_bytes <= 0:
+        parser.error("a command and positive bounds are required")
+    if Path(args.stdout_name).name != args.stdout_name:
+        parser.error("stdout name must be a filename")
+    result = run_command(arguments, Path.cwd(), args.evidence_dir, args.timeout_seconds,
+                         args.max_output_bytes, args.stdout_name, args.split_output)
+    print(json.dumps(result))
+    raise SystemExit(result["wrapper_exit_code"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Self-chat E2E
+
+## Existing contract and scope
+
+This scenario exercises real `cmd/wukongim` processes through public WKProto and
+HTTP. It adds coverage, not a new release gate or a new messaging guarantee.
+`internal/runtime/persondirectory/projector.go` explicitly supports self-channels
+with one distinct UID. `TestRuntimeSuppressesOnlyExactSenderSession` in
+`internal/runtime/delivery/runtime_test.go` retains delivery to the sender's other
+sessions. The public Devices guide describes UID-scoped persistent history and
+client-side receive deduplication. Do not require exactly-once wire delivery.
+
+## Failure inventory (recorded before the test)
+
+- A valid authenticated UID cannot SEND to its own person Channel, or a default
+  auth fixture accidentally accepts unprovisioned credentials.
+- A second device for the same UID is suppressed with the sending session, or
+  the sending session receives its own WKProto message.
+- WKProto or HTTP acknowledgments disagree with received identity, sequence,
+  sender, Channel, payload, or persistent flags.
+- Self-membership projection never converges, or complete public history omits,
+  duplicates, reorders, or corrupts an acknowledged message.
+- All processes stop and restart but retained history becomes readable only
+  after another SEND, credentials disappear, or a later append loses old rows
+  or fails to advance the sequence.
+- A permissive retry masks a malformed response or successful wrong history;
+  incomplete history pagination is mistaken for the full retained history.
+- A failed case omits its bounded JSON receipt or leaves child processes alive.
+
+## Execution
+
+Use production-default Token authentication, separate APP and WEB credentials,
+256 Hash Slots, and both a single-node cluster and a three-node cluster. The
+three-node devices connect through different nodes. Send from each device and
+through HTTP, then verify full ascending `/channel/messagesync` pagination on
+every ingress using explicit `start_message_seq=1` and `pull_mode=1`; both range
+bounds zero select the latest page rather than the beginning. Stop and join all
+processes, restart the same data directories,
+verify retained history before another SEND, and prove another authenticated
+send in each direction after restart. Receivers ACK and deduplicate only exact
+previously verified MessageIDs; unexpected messages or changed duplicates fail.
+
+Only the explicit HTTP 503 `unavailable` envelope can be retried for history
+recovery. Projection polling uses `/conversation/list`; a successful history
+page is checked immediately without correctness polling. Recovery sequence
+positions may contain internal barriers; require strictly increasing business
+sequences, not gap-free allocation.
+
+Run:
+
+```sh
+WK_E2E_SELF_CHAT_REPORT=/absolute/self-chat.json GOWORK=off go test -tags=e2e ./test/e2e/message/self_chat -count=1 -timeout=4m -p=1 -v
+```
+
+`WK_E2E_BINARY` may select a frozen product binary. The receipt records its
+SHA-256, topology, stage, authenticated devices, acknowledged message facts,
+bounded receive counts, and exact history observations. It includes no tokens.
+The default receipt is `/tmp/wukongim-self-chat.json`; choose a unique path for
+concurrent runs. Keep one-off helpers here and update both E2E catalogs when the
+scenario contract or command changes.

+func TestSelfChatPersistsAcrossClusterRestart(t *testing.T) {
+	report := struct {
+		Version             int            `json:"schema_version"`
+		StartedAt           time.Time      `json:"started_at"`
+		FinishedAt          time.Time      `json:"finished_at"`
+		Passed              bool           `json:"passed"`
+		HashSlots           int            `json:"hash_slots"`
+		TokenAuthentication string         `json:"token_authentication"`
+		SuppressionWindowMS int            `json:"suppression_window_ms"`
+		Cases               []*caseReceipt `json:"cases"`
+	}{Version: 1, StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(), HashSlots: 256, TokenAuthentication: "production_default", SuppressionWindowMS: 1000}
+	defer func() {
+		report.Passed, report.FinishedAt = !t.Failed(), time.Now().UTC()
+		path := os.Getenv("WK_E2E_SELF_CHAT_REPORT")
+		if path == "" {
+			path = filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "wukongim-self-chat.json")
+		}
+		body, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
+		if err == nil {

+		}
+		if err == nil {
+			err = os.WriteFile(path, append(body, '\n'), 0600)

+			runSelfChat(t, out)
+		})
+	}

+func runSelfChat(t *testing.T, out *caseReceipt) {
+	t.Helper()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	opts := []suite.Option{suite.WithManagerHTTP()}
+	for nodeID := 1; nodeID <= out.Nodes; nodeID++ {
+		opts = append(opts, suite.WithNodeConfigOverrides(uint64(nodeID), map[string]string{
+			"WK_CLUSTER_HASH_SLOT_COUNT": "256", "WK_CLUSTER_INITIAL_SLOT_COUNT": "12",
+			"WK_CLUSTER_CHANNEL_REPLICA_N": strconv.Itoa(out.Nodes),
+		}))
+	}
+	cluster := suite.New(t).StartStaticCluster(out.Nodes, opts...)
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		if t.Failed() {
+			t.Logf("self-chat phase=%s\n%s", out.Phase, cluster.DumpDiagnostics())
+		}
+	})
+	f, err := os.Open(cluster.MustNode(1).Process.BinaryPath)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	hash := sha256.New()
+	_, err = io.Copy(hash, f)
+	require.NoError(t, f.Close())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	out.BinarySHA256 = hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
+	require.NoError(t, cluster.WaitClusterReady(ctx))
+	_, err = cluster.WaitSlotLeadersStable(ctx, time.Second)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	// This negative control proves the default fixture did not bypass Token auth.
+	invalid, err := wkclient.New(wkclient.Config{Addr: cluster.MustNode(1).GatewayAddr(), OperationTimeout: 5 * time.Second})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = invalid.Connect(ctx, wkclient.ConnectOptions{UID: selfUID, DeviceID: "invalid", DeviceFlag: frame.APP, Token: "unregistered"})
+	require.NoError(t, invalid.Close())
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, frame.ReasonAuthFail.String())
+	out.InvalidAuthRefused = true
+	for _, flag := range []frame.DeviceFlag{frame.APP, frame.WEB} {
+		_, err = suite.PostJSON(ctx, "http://"+cluster.MustNode(1).APIAddr()+"/user/token", map[string]any{
+			"uid": selfUID, "token": tokenFor(flag), "device_flag": int(flag), "device_level": 0,
+		}, nil)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+	}
+
+	for generation := 0; generation < 2; generation++ {
+		out.Phase = fmt.Sprintf("generation-%d", generation)
+		app := connectDevice(t, ctx, cluster.MustNode(1), frame.APP, "app")
+		web := connectDevice(t, ctx, cluster.MustNode(uint64(out.Nodes)), frame.WEB, "web")
+		for i, pair := range [][2]*device{{app, web}, {web, app}} {
+			key := fmt.Sprintf("self-%d-wkproto-%d", generation, i)
+			ack, err := pair[0].client.Send(ctx, wkclient.Message{ClientSeq: uint64(i + 1), ClientMsgNo: key,
+				ChannelID: selfUID, ChannelType: frame.ChannelTypePerson, Payload: []byte(key)})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, frame.ReasonSuccess, ack.ReasonCode)
+			require.Equal(t, key, ack.ClientMsgNo)
+			require.Equal(t, uint64(i+1), ack.ClientSeq)
+			fact := acknowledge(t, out, ack.MessageID, ack.MessageSeq, key)
+			pair[1].allowed[fact.ID] = fact
+			awaitReceive(t, ctx, out, pair[1], fact.ID)
+		}
+		key := fmt.Sprintf("self-%d-http", generation)
+		ack, err := suite.PostMessageSendEventually(ctx, cluster.MustNode(uint64(out.Nodes)).APIAddr(), map[string]any{
+			"from_uid": selfUID, "channel_id": selfUID, "channel_type": frame.ChannelTypePerson,
+			"client_msg_no": key, "payload": []byte(key), "header": map[string]int{"no_persist": 0, "sync_once": 0, "red_dot": 0},
+		})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, uint8(frame.ReasonSuccess), ack.Reason)
+		fact := acknowledge(t, out, ack.MessageID, ack.MessageSeq, key)
+		for _, d := range []*device{app, web} {
+			d.allowed[fact.ID] = fact
+			awaitReceive(t, ctx, out, d, fact.ID)
+			// A quiet bounded window checks sender suppression while permitting exact
+			// RECV redelivery, which is independent from durable-history uniqueness.
+			quietCtx, quietCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
+			for {
+				packet, err := d.client.Recv(quietCtx)
+				if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) && ctx.Err() == nil {
+					break
+				}
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				verifyReceive(t, ctx, out, d, packet)
+			}
+			quietCancel()
+			out.SuppressionWindows++
+		}
+		// Membership is an asynchronous directory projection. Wait on that public
+		// projection explicitly; never poll a successful but incomplete history.
+		suite.RequireConversationEventuallyWithin(t, *cluster.MustNode(1), selfUID, selfUID, 15*time.Second, func(item suite.ConversationListItem) error {
+			if item.ChannelType != int64(frame.ChannelTypePerson) || item.LastMessage == nil || item.LastMessage.MessageSeq != fact.Seq {
+				return fmt.Errorf("self conversation has not projected acknowledged tail %d", fact.Seq)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+		checkAllHistory(t, ctx, cluster, out)
+		require.NoError(t, app.close())
+		require.NoError(t, web.close())
+		if generation == 0 {
+			out.Phase = "whole-cluster-restart-before-any-send"
+			for i := range cluster.Nodes {
+				require.NoError(t, cluster.Nodes[i].Stop())
+			}
+			for i := range cluster.Nodes {
+				require.NoError(t, cluster.StartStoppedNode(cluster.Nodes[i].Spec.ID))
+			}
+			out.Restarts++
+			require.NoError(t, cluster.WaitHTTPReady(ctx))
+			checkAllHistory(t, ctx, cluster, out)
+			require.NoError(t, cluster.WaitClusterReady(ctx))
+		}
+	}
+	out.Phase = "complete"
+}
+
+func tokenFor(flag frame.DeviceFlag) string { return fmt.Sprintf("self-chat-fixture-token-%d", flag) }
+
+func connectDevice(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, node *suite.StartedNode, flag frame.DeviceFlag, name string) *device {
+	t.Helper()
+	c, err := wkclient.New(wkclient.Config{Addr: node.GatewayAddr(), OperationTimeout: 5 * time.Second, AckTimeout: 5 * time.Second})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	d := &device{name: name, client: c, allowed: make(map[string]messageFact), seen: make(map[string]bool)}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, d.close()) })

+// close joins each terminal client once, whether a phase or test cleanup owns it.
+func (d *device) close() error {
+	if d.closed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	d.closed = true
+	return d.client.Close()
+}
+
+func acknowledge(t *testing.T, out *caseReceipt, id int64, seq uint64, key string) messageFact {
+	t.Helper()
+	require.Positive(t, id)
+	require.Positive(t, seq)
+	if len(out.Acknowledged) > 0 {
+		require.Greater(t, seq, out.Acknowledged[len(out.Acknowledged)-1].Seq)
+	}
+	for _, old := range out.Acknowledged {
+		require.NotEqual(t, old.ID, strconv.FormatInt(id, 10))
+	}
+	fact := messageFact{ID: strconv.FormatInt(id, 10), Seq: seq, ClientMsgNo: key, FromUID: selfUID,
+		ChannelID: selfUID, ChannelType: frame.ChannelTypePerson, Payload: []byte(key)}
+	out.Acknowledged = append(out.Acknowledged, fact)
+	return fact
+}
+
+func awaitReceive(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, out *caseReceipt, d *device, id string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	readCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	for !d.seen[id] {
+		packet, err := d.client.Recv(readCtx)
+		require.NoError(t, err, "device=%s message=%s", d.name, id)
+		verifyReceive(t, ctx, out, d, packet)
+	}
+}
+
+func verifyReceive(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, out *caseReceipt, d *device, packet *frame.RecvPacket) {
+	t.Helper()
+	id := strconv.FormatInt(packet.MessageID, 10)
+	want, ok := d.allowed[id]
+	require.True(t, ok, "unexpected RECV or exact-sender echo: device=%s id=%s", d.name, id)
+	require.Equal(t, want.Seq, packet.MessageSeq)
+	require.Equal(t, want.ClientMsgNo, packet.ClientMsgNo)
+	require.Equal(t, want.FromUID, packet.FromUID)
+	require.Equal(t, want.ChannelID, packet.ChannelID)
+	require.Equal(t, want.ChannelType, packet.ChannelType)
+	require.Equal(t, want.Payload, packet.Payload)
+	require.False(t, packet.NoPersist)
+	require.False(t, packet.SyncOnce)
+	require.False(t, packet.RedDot)
+	require.Less(t, len(out.Receives), 64, "bounded receive observation exceeded")
+	out.Receives = append(out.Receives, receiveReceipt{Phase: out.Phase, Device: d.name, MessageID: id, Seq: packet.MessageSeq, Duplicate: d.seen[id]})
+	d.seen[id] = true
+	require.NoError(t, d.client.RecvAck(ctx, packet.MessageID, packet.MessageSeq))
+}
+
+func checkAllHistory(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, cluster *suite.StartedCluster, out *caseReceipt) {
+	t.Helper()
+	for i := range cluster.Nodes {
+		node := &cluster.Nodes[i]
+		out.History = append(out.History, historyReceipt{Phase: out.Phase, NodeID: node.Spec.ID})
+		observation := &out.History[len(out.History)-1]
+		readCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
+		// An explicit inclusive sequence starts at the beginning. Both bounds zero
+		// select the latest page even with pull_mode=1, not the oldest page.
+		cursor := uint64(1)
+		for pageNo := 0; pageNo < 8; pageNo++ {
+			page := historyPage{StartSeq: cursor}
+			for {
+				_, err := suite.PostJSON(readCtx, "http://"+node.APIAddr()+"/channel/messagesync", map[string]any{
+					"login_uid": selfUID, "channel_id": selfUID, "channel_type": frame.ChannelTypePerson,
+					"start_message_seq": cursor, "end_message_seq": 0, "pull_mode": 1, "limit": 2,
+				}, &page)
+				if err == nil {
+					break
+				}
+				require.True(t, historyUnavailable(err), "history node=%d phase=%s: %v", node.Spec.ID, out.Phase, err)
+				observation.TemporaryRetries++
+				select {
+				case <-readCtx.Done():
+					require.NoError(t, readCtx.Err(), "history recovery did not finish")
+				case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
+				}
+			}
+			observation.Pages++
+			observation.LastPage = &page
+			require.Contains(t, []int{0, 1}, page.More)
+			require.NotEmpty(t, page.Messages, "successful empty history cannot hide an acknowledged message")
+			require.LessOrEqual(t, len(page.Messages), 2)
+			for _, row := range page.Messages {
+				position := len(observation.Messages)
+				require.Less(t, position, len(out.Acknowledged), "extra or duplicate durable message")
+				require.Equal(t, out.Acknowledged[position], row, "history node=%d row=%d", node.Spec.ID, position)
+				observation.Messages = append(observation.Messages, row)
+			}
+			if page.More == 0 {
+				observation.Complete = true
+				break
+			}
+			next := page.Messages[len(page.Messages)-1].Seq + 1
+			require.Greater(t, next, cursor)
+			cursor = next
+		}
+		cancel()
+		require.True(t, observation.Complete, "history pagination did not terminate")
+		require.Equal(t, out.Acknowledged, observation.Messages, "complete history must retain every acknowledged message")
+	}
+}

+func historyUnavailable(err error) bool {
+	var statusErr *suite.HTTPStatusError
+	var body struct {
+		Code   string `json:"code"`
+		Status int    `json:"status"`
+	}
+	return errors.As(err, &statusErr) && statusErr.StatusCode == http.StatusServiceUnavailable &&
+		json.Unmarshal([]byte(statusErr.Body), &body) == nil && body.Code == "unavailable" && body.Status == http.StatusServiceUnavailable
+}
